item.title: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu: I’m not getting involved in the Israeli election
item.description: Vice President JD Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu in Israel's election despite Trump's support, explains he is focusing on the midterms.

item.title: Following Gantz's withdrawal: Right-wing leaders step up pressure on Ofer Winter
item.description: Benny Gantz's withdrawal from the Knesset race sparks calls on the right to prevent wasted votes on parties polling below the electoral threshold.

item.title: Report: Hegseth visits Israel and meets Netanyahu
item.description:
US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during a visit to Israel on Monday, two sources with knowledge told Axios.
Read more

item.title: Ben Gvir to Arutz Sheva: If we don't win double-digit seats, they'll leave us out
item.description: Despite Netanyahu's promises of a senior position in the next government, Ben Gvir fears the Prime Minister will prefer a coalition with Eisenkot.

item.title: Report: Witkoff and Kushner to travel to Norway for talks with Ukraine
item.description:
US President Donald Trump's envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, are planning to travel to Norway for talks with Ukraine, Reuters reported, citing three sources familiar with the matter.
Two of the sources said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is also expected to participate in the talks.

item.title: Concerns in Syria over possible unusual move by Netanyahu
item.description: Syrian officials fear Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could take extraordinary action on Syrian territory to gain a political advantage ahead of Israel's elections.

item.title: Trump: Paris is going to be a Muslim city very soon
item.description: President Trump criticizes Macron over violent riots in France, saying he had warned him about radical Islam and urging him to close the country's borders.

item.title: Urich's dramatic testimony in Qatargate Affair
item.description: Netanyahu's adviser estimated during his interrogation in the Qatargate investigation that his work promoting Qatar's image continued throughout much of the war and claimed that he had not informed the Prime Minister about it.

item.title: Yes, there’s a Genocide being waged in Gaza!
item.description: The genocide that is being waged in the Middle East is from the Arabs to the Arabs. Opinion.

item.title: Poll: Arab parties reach record high of 15 Knesset seats
item.description: In two polls published Monday evening, the Arab parties reached record levels of support, significantly increasing their political strength.

item.title: Extremists throw stones at Karlin Rebbe's vehicle
item.description: Outrage has erupted in the haredi community following a violent incident in Beit Shemesh in which a group of extremists attacked the vehicle of the Karlin-Stolin Rebbe with stones.

item.title: Jewish women punched in face in London antisemitic attacks, suspect arrested
item.description: At least two Jewish women were assaulted in Stamford Hill, with one suffering significant bruising. Police arrested a suspect on suspicion of racially and religiously aggravated grievous bodily harm.

item.title: After announcing his withdrawal: Gantz's message to the Anti-Netanyahu bloc
item.description: Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz delivered a statement following his withdrawal from the Knesset race and warned party leaders: "Do not take us back to October 6.'

item.title: Aliyah as rebirth
item.description: While Aliyah involves a journey, it isn’t just about moving to Israel. Instead, it is a rebirth. And just as every birthing experience is unique, so too, every Aliyah story is unique.

item.title: Macron lectures Israel while France burns
item.description: A president so confident about criticizing another democracy should bring the same urgency to protecting his own citizens. Opinion.

item.title: 'Donald, we have a job to finish': Netanyahu thanks Trump for endorsement
item.description: Netanyahu calls Trump to thank him for his endorsement; Trump predicts a major victory and calls him a warrior. 'You're the man I want by my side, Bibi.'

item.title: Suspected terrorist infiltration in Evyatar
item.description:
A short while ago, sirens were sounded regarding a suspected terrorist infiltration in the area of Evyatar.
The IDF stated that it remains in close contact with the local communities and security forces in the region.

item.title: Trump backs Netanyahu, but what is the real reason?
item.description: Former Israeli diplomat Yaki Dayan explains Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu, dismisses the polling theory, and warns of another round with Iran.

item.title: World first? Wounded soldier evacuated from front lines by drone
item.description: Ukraine's military announced that it successfully evacuated a wounded soldier from a combat zone using a heavy-lift drone after minefields and the threat of Russian drones made evacuation by land impossible.
